name: ntfy Notification Channel
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: Route McHarbor workflow, alert, and backup events to an ntfy topic via HTTP POST (https://ntfy.sh or self-hosted). Set the server URL + topic, optionally add a topic-scoped access token or HTTP Basic auth, and the plugin handles Test (publishes a real test message) + Send (publishes Title as the Title header and Message as the body). Supports priority levels (min/low/default/high/urgent) and emoji tags. Adds the channels:use-comm-ntfy permission so operators can grant 'send alerts via this channel' as a discrete, auditable capability.
